newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - January 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - January 22.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Delegation of Tamil and Moslem parties to meet President Chandrika Kumaratunga on Wednesday to discuss contentious areas in government devolution package and difficulties faced by Tamils and Moslems in north and east.
Visiting Indian External Affairs Minister Inder Kumar Gujral tells minority Tamil parties India will not interfere in Sri Lanka's internal affairs.
Army sets up directorate on humanitarian law to improve discipline among troops.
Local government polls likely to be held on March 17 in areas outside north and east.
Air force Kfir crashes into Negombo lagoon after pilot ejects.
United National Party tells minority Tamil and Moslem parties it is ready to help find a speedy solution to ethnic problem in talks in parliamnetary select committee.
